messages.content: I’m reviewing OAI-746291 before the cancellation deadline. The confirmation now just says king room in one place, and the hotel notice mentions work near a beach path. Can you verify exactly what we booked and which ocean access will actually be open September 12 through 18?

I’ll check the reservation details against the hotel’s room-category record and ask the property to confirm both the balcony and the beach route in writing. I’ll also verify whether the construction affects the resort boardwalk or only a secondary path.
Please do. I don’t want to keep a nearly $3,900 reservation if the balcony was lost or we’ll have to leave the property to reach the beach.

The hotel has confirmed in writing that OAI-746291 remains an Ocean View King, not a standard resort-view king. It includes one king bed and a private furnished balcony facing the ocean. The shortened wording on the guest-facing confirmation did not change the booked category.
Good. What did they say about the path closure?

The temporary closure is for the northern dune crossover near the far end of the property. During your stay, the main resort beach boardwalk beside the pool complex is scheduled to remain open. It provides direct access from the resort grounds to the sand without crossing a public road. The hotel estimates a three- to six-minute walk from the guest-room buildings, depending on room assignment.
Does the work affect the ocean view or create construction noise near the rooms?

The property says the work is limited to the dune path and will occur during daytime hours. It does not block the ocean-facing balconies. They cannot guarantee that no work will be audible outdoors, but they do not expect meaningful noise at the main guest buildings. I’ve added their written room and access confirmation to the reservation record.
That answers it. Keep the reservation as it is. Please confirm the deadline and that nothing else was charged today.

The Omni reservation remains active and unchanged for September 12 through 18. Free cancellation ends at 5:00 p.m. local hotel time on September 5; after that, the $1,196.32 deposit becomes the cancellation penalty. No additional charge was made today. The total remains $3,874.56, and Morgan Thompson is still listed as the second guest.
